# Loaders — `GaxiaServer` and `Gaxia` themselves

**Core** (always installed). Besides the packages (`GaxiaServer.Economy`, `Gaxia.UI.Toast`, …), the two loaders have these members.

## `GaxiaServer` (server only)

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
```

- `GaxiaServer.VERSION : string`
- `GaxiaServer.Boot(): ()`
  Start the boot services (idempotent; also runs on first service access): ServerStorage.GaxiaFeatures if present, else the picked services plus every installed package with Boot = true (Packages.lua), else Config/Features.
- `GaxiaServer.IsEnabled(name: Types.ServiceName | string): boolean`
  True once the service has started (a boot service after Boot, or any service after first use). Never loads anything.
- `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled(name: Types.ServiceName | string): boolean`
  True when the package is installed in this place: any package name from Packages.lua ("Economy", "UI.Toast", "Util", "Promise", …). Never loads a service.

## `Gaxia` (server and client)

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
```

- `Gaxia.VERSION : string`
- `Gaxia.Tween(instance: Instance, info: TweenInfo, props: { [string]: any }): Tween`
- `Gaxia.IsInstalled(key: string): boolean`
  True when the module behind a key is installed ("Signal", "Camera", "Util", "UI.Toast", "Util.Table"). Client keys are false on the server; server packages are not visible here (use GaxiaServer.IsInstalled). Never loads anything.

Server Scripts may require `Gaxia` too, for the shared modules (`Gaxia.Net`, `Gaxia.Signal`, `Gaxia.Trove`, `Gaxia.State`, `Gaxia.Flags`, …). Client modules (`Gaxia.UI`, `Gaxia.Input`, …) are nil on the server.
